bass.tags: Industrial techno with a heavy EBM influence. A distorted, overdriven kick drum drives a relentless four-on-the-floor pattern at 135 BPM in the key of D minor. A resonant, metallic synth sequence provides a rhythmic ostinato with a high-pass filter sweep. Gritty, saturated bass pulses lock to the kick. Percussion includes a sharp, compressed snare on beats 2 and 4, layered with metallic hi-hats and industrial foley hits. A dark, atmospheric pad provides a dissonant harmonic layer in the background. The track features a breakdown with a rising pitch-shifted synth lead and a sudden re-entry of the full percussion section.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum enters, four-on-the-floor]
[metallic synth sequence with high-pass filter sweep]

[Section A]
[saturated bass pulses enter]
[sharp snare on beats 2 and 4]
[closed hi-hats in sixteenth notes]

[Breakdown]
[kick and snare drop out]
[rising pitch-shifted synth lead]
[atmospheric pad swells]

[Section B]
[full percussion re-enters]
[industrial foley hits and metallic percussion layers]
[resonant synth ostinato becomes more aggressive]

drums.tags: Industrial rock with heavy electronic elements. Distorted electric guitar plays a syncopated, palm-muted riff in the intro before opening into sustained power chords. A gritty, overdriven synth bass follows the guitar rhythm. The drum kit features a processed, punchy snare and a heavy kick drum with a steady eighth-note hi-hat pattern. Atmospheric, high-pitched synth textures and occasional industrial sound effects provide background layers. The track is in the key of D minor at 120 BPM.

[Main Section]
